plan.title: Recreate Order with Extremely Large Price

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ rather than creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required withdrawal visibility configuration.
Allow the live-event configuration required for this scenario.
Reach the RFQ Responses tab where the event Settings action is available.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order window opened.
Enter the extremely large price in the Recreate Order dialog.
Submit the large price to observe Procol's handling.
Record the resulting success, error, warning, or other toast response.
Confirm the resulting screen has no crash, server error, raw values, or rendering corruption.
